title: Quantum Quest — Quantum Chemistry Study Game
author: Dr. Dan (ItsDrDan)
description: Practice light and photons, the electromagnetic spectrum, the photoelectric effect, Bohr transitions, matter waves, quantum numbers, electron configurations, orbital diagrams, magnetism, and periodic trends. Students choose their course: CHEM 1A (default, 1,706 problems) or a focused CHEM 3A set (688 problems: simple light calculations, Bohr model and spectra, shells and subshells, orbital diagrams, full and noble-gas configurations of main-group atoms and ions, and basic periodic trends). Includes diagrams, typed configurations, hints, explanations, skill-check prep, keyboard shortcuts, XP, and achievements. New: successive-ionization-energy tables (period 2 and 3, NIST data) to identify the element, count valence electrons, and write its noble-gas configuration. Also adds ACS-style items: valence-shell configurations, impossible vs. ground-state configurations, identifying a species from its configuration, electronegativity trends, and stable-ion prediction from ionization energies.
